algorithm: PPO (Stable-Baselines3) with an object-trajectory-tracking reward plus pre-grasp-based exploration initialization (PGDM)
success_criterion: fraction of timesteps within a 1cm threshold of the exemplar object's center-of-mass position
headline_metric: Success rate S(X_hat), averaged over 50 tasks, 3 seeds, 50M training samples
headline_value: PGDM overall Success 74.5%, COM Error 5.23e-3 m, Ori Error 0.33 rad (Table I); PGDM-only competitive with or beats DeepMimic, GRAFF*, and Task Curriculum (with/without PGDM init) on TCDM-30
human_data: GRAB (used only for object 6-DoF pose trajectories in 40/50 tasks; accompanying human hand-mesh trajectories explicitly not used, only a single pre-grasp frame retargeted for exploration initialization)
note_gaps: the pre-grasp IK retargeting error itself (for the GRAB-sourced tasks) is never separately measured; real-robot validation is a single unquantified qualitative demo with no trial count or success rate
retargeting_objective: for pre-grasps only: inverse kinematics fits the robot hand's fingertip positions to a single human hand pose frame near first contact, used solely to initialize RL exploration; full object trajectories are used directly as the RL goal with no hand-trajectory retargeting
